SELECT s.ID "id",s.PERSON_NAME "name",s.SUPPLIER_ID "supplierId",p.COMPANY_NAME "companyName" FROM SMT_SUPPLIER_PERSON s JOIN SMT_SECURITYAREA_SUPPLIER p ON p.ID=s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE p.PARK_ID=#{park} AND p.DEL_FLAG=0 AND s.DEL_FLAG=0

SELECT p.ID "id",p.VISITOR_NAME "name",p.VISITOR_PHOTO_ID "photoCode", f.ID "id",f.FELLOW_NAME "name",f.FELLOW_PHOTO_ID "photoCode", p.STATUS "status",p.START_TIME "startTime",p.END_TIME "endTime",p.PROMOTER_BADGE "promoterBadge",p.SMS_CODE "credential",p.COMPANY "companyName" FROM SMT_VISITOR p JOIN SMT_FELLOW_VISITOR f ON f.VISITOR_ID=p.ID WHERE p.PARK_ID=#{park} AND p.DEL_FLAG=0

SELECT p.IDf.ID "id", f.FELLOW_NAME "name",f.FELLOW_PHOTO_ID "photoCode",p.VISITOR_NAME "parentName",p.VISITOR_PHOTO_ID "parentPhotoCode", p.STATUS "status",p.START_TIME "startTime",p.END_TIME "endTime",p.PERSON_TYPE "visitorType",p.SMS_CODE "credential",p.COMPANY "companyName",p.AREA_TYPE "areaType" FROM SMT_ADMITTANCE_APPLY p JOIN SMT_ADMITTANCE_FELLOW f ON f.VISITOR_ID=p.ID WHERE p.PARK_ID=#{park} AND f.IS_MAIN=10
